summary: Downward induction on j, correcting the coordinate j with the shared flag vector of index j.

steps.claim: From IsNormalForm(j, γ) choose, for every frame index a ≥ j, vectors X_a, Y_a with f X_a = γf Y_a, (Y_a)_a = 1 and X_a, Y_a vanishing above a.
Induction on j downwards from ϱ+1.
steps.lean:
induction' j using reverseInduction with j i
  use 0, 0, by grind, by simp
  choose x z _ using i (by grind)
  use x + (y - z) j • X j, z + (y - z) j • Y j; simp; grind

steps.claim: Base j = ϱ+1: no frame index is ≥ ϱ+1, so x = y' = 0 will do (f·0 = γf·0).

Step from j+1 to j: by the induction hypothesis i there are x, z with z_a = y_a for a ≥ j+1 and f x = γf z. Then x + (y_j − z_j)X_j and z + (y_j − z_j)Y_j satisfy the equation (linearity), agree with y at j (since (Y_j)_j = 1) and still agree with y above j (Y_j vanishes above j).
